summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating as the central hub for open-source models, hosting over 2 million models while the top 0.01% of models account for nearly half of all downloads. Platforms have diversified into distinct niches: some focus on model discovery and community (Hugging Face), others on low-cost serverless inference (Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate), local deployment (Ollama), and enterprise-grade managed services (AWS Bedrock). Qwen derivatives, gguf-format models, and frameworks like lerobot are driving the fastest repository growth, while DeepSeek surpassed Mistral in cumulative Hugging Face downloads in January 2026 with 128.2 million downloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source AI model repository, dataset hub, and inference platform serving as the default destination for discovering, sharing, and deploying machine learning models
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited inference; PRO plan ~$9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour based on hardware selected
features: 2 million+ models, datasets, and Spaces hosted
Inference Providers tier routing to partners like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra
Model cards, versioning, and community discussions
Spaces for hosting interactive ML demos
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain tools
Leaderboards and evaluation benchmarks
Private model and dataset hosting for enterprises
Top 200 models (0.01%) account for 49.6% of all downloads
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and enterprises needing a one-stop hub for model discovery, collaboration, versioning, and community-driven evaluation

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model deployment tool that allows developers and individuals to download and run open-source LLMs entirely on their own hardware with minimal setup
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models optimized for local use (gguf and similar formats)
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are only hardware and electricity; no API fees
features: One-command model download and run experience
Supports popular models including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Gemma
OpenAI-compatible local API for easy integration
GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon (Metal), NVIDIA CUDA, and AMD ROCm
Model library with curated gguf-format models
Privacy-first: all inference runs locally with no data sent externally
Modelfile system for customizing and creating derivative models
Desktop apps available for macOS, Windows, and Linux
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, hobbyists, and enterprises with compliance requirements who want to run powerful LLMs entirely on local hardware without per-token costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Serverless cloud inference platform offering a pay-per-second API for running open-source models without managing infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second based on GPU type used; no upfront costs; billing starts when compute starts; examples range from fractions of a cent per image generation to a few cents per LLM call
features: 50,000+ open-source models accessible via simple REST API
Scales to zero when not in use, eliminating idle costs
Supports image generation, video, audio, LLMs, and multimodal models
Custom model deployment with private endpoints
Webhooks and async prediction support
Official client libraries for Python, Node.js, and more
Community model sharing and versioning
Cog open-source tool for packaging models as containers
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting the simplest possible API to add AI capabilities to applications without DevOps overhead, especially for image and creative media generation use cases

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance, low-cost cloud inference platform for open-source LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API, also offering fine-tuning and training services
platforms.model_count: 100+ leading open-source models including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Mixtral variants
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing; among the lowest in the market for open-source LLM inference; e.g., Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10-$0.18 per million tokens; fine-tuning priced per GPU hour; volume discounts available
features: OpenAI-compatible API for easy migration from proprietary models
Consistently ranked as lowest-cost inference option for major open-source LLMs
Dedicated endpoints for guaranteed throughput
Fine-tuning service with support for LoRA and full fine-tuning
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) support
Batch inference for high-volume offline workloads
Fast inference with FlashAttention and custom kernels
SOC 2 Type II compliant for enterprise security
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers, startups, and enterprises running high-volume LLM inference workloads who want OpenAI API compatibility without the cost premium of proprietary models

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Production-grade, high-throughput inference platform specializing in fast and efficient serving of open-source LLMs and multimodal models for enterprise applications
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open-source models with a focus on production-ready, high-performance options
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive pricing comparable to Together AI; serverless and dedicated deployment options; dedicated GPU instances for latency-sensitive workloads priced per hour
features: Industry-leading inference speed with FireAttention proprietary inference engine
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling and structured output (JSON mode) support
Image and vision model support alongside text LLMs
Fine-tuning service with fast turnaround
Dedicated deployments for guaranteed SLAs
Listed as a top-5 value AI hosting platform for 2026
Enterprise compliance features and private deployment options
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and developers building latency-sensitive production applications who need consistently fast inference speeds, reliable SLAs, and robust function-calling support with open-source models

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed enterprise cloud service for accessing and deploying both proprietary and open-source foundation models from multiple providers within the AWS ecosystem
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, Amazon Titan, Stability AI, Cohere, and AI21 Labs
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (on-demand) for most models; Provisioned Throughput for guaranteed capacity billed per hour; model prices vary by provider, e.g., Claude Sonnet at ~$3 per million input tokens; no infrastructure management costs
features: Access to models from Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI, and Amazon Titan in one API
Deep AWS ecosystem integration with S3, Lambda, SageMaker, and IAM
Knowledge Bases for managed RAG with vector store integration
Agents for autonomous multi-step task execution
Model fine-tuning and continued pre-training within AWS
Guardrails for content filtering and responsible AI controls
VPC support and PrivateLink for data never leaving the AWS network
Enterprise compliance: HIPAA, SOC, ISO, GDPR ready
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance while accessing a curated selection of both proprietary and open-source foundation models through a unified managed API
